message.content: In Christian tradition, the emphasis is often placed on Jesus Christ as the central and ultimate figure—he is regarded as the fulfillment of prophetic expectations. However, many Christians also hold the Hebrew prophets in high regard, seeing them as foundational teachers and forecasters of God's plan. Different Christian communities may highlight various prophets (e.g., Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah) depending on their theological focus and scriptural interpretation.
